decisions.statement: The tracks picked are the tracks the unheard-picking module picks.
An artist is followed where that artist's own page says so.
The playlist kept up to date is the one the `playlist/unheard` page names.
What the playlist gains and loses is what the unheard-reconciling module says.
Tracks leave the playlist before tracks reach it.
A run wanting no track empties the playlist.
A planning run reads Spotify and writes nothing.
The answer counts what was added, what was removed and what was kept.
A planning run counts what it would add and remove, and counts nothing done.
The answer names the playlist's link.

definition: the command keeping a playlist of what Alan's followed artists made and he has not heard
